lock.help: Use a password separate from VPN credentials: at least 8 characters and at most 72 UTF-8 bytes. Locking is immediate, with no role exemptions. Unlocking lasts 10 minutes; assignment and mobile provisioning do not require it.
lock.invalid: Use at least 8 characters, at most 72 UTF-8 bytes and two matching passwords.
lock.mustDiffer: The lock password must differ from the VPN password.

errors.PROFILE_LOCKED: The configuration is locked or your proof expired. Unlock it again.
errors.PROFILE_LOCK_PASSWORD_INVALID: The password does not meet the required limits.
errors.PROFILE_UNLOCK_RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again.
errors.PROFILE_ENGINE_LINK_AMBIGUOUS: Multiple engine accounts match this profile. Resolve the link before adding a lock.
errors.PROFILE_ENGINE_LINKED: This profile is linked to an engine account and cannot be deleted separately.
